evals.name: friend-gift
evals.prompt: 친구 생일 선물 추천해줘. 5만원 정도. 친구는 게임회사 PM이야
expectations: Options are of clearly different kinds
Each option has a one-line reason tied to this person (e.g. PM / monitor-heavy day)
Includes a practical detail per option (price range, time, etc.)
Asks at most one question before giving options
Does not give a scoring table or a single final pick
Ends with a handoff line inviting '골라줘' or '다른 거'

evals.name: housewarming-missing-info
expectations: Asks exactly one short question (or states an assumption) instead of a long questionnaire
Gives 3-4 options (not more) after the answer
Each option has a one-line reason tied to what was learned
Does not give a scoring table or a single final pick
Ends with a handoff line inviting '골라줘' or '다른 거'
